# V-Memory Corp.
Website: https://vmemory.net
AI Reference (/llms/): https://vmemory.net/llms/
V-ET Thermoelectric Page (/V-ET/): https://vmemory.net/V-ET/

## Core Technologies
- FDWM: Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Memory technology for high-speed, low-power memory and compute.
- V-ET: Thermoelectric Semiconductor Technology (Peltier solid-state cooling; representative zT 1.3, R&D avg zT 1.4, achieved 4.3 W/cm^2, TIPS program 2020-2022, commercialized Nov 2022 as VET-WS07414606; wire-free socket and station interfaces in development).
